supersession_reason: Archive path-only inspection showed that the broad glob includes difficulty-derived duplicates. No description text was opened; v2 freezes the four canonical split files.

source.title: CityNav: A Large-Scale Dataset for Real-World Aerial Navigation
source.language_provenance: Natural-language goal descriptions paired with human demonstration trajectories and collected from participants in a web-based simulator.

evaluation_population.deduplication: none; report raw records and normalized-unique count separately
evaluation_population.split_reporting: overall and every source split found by the registered glob
evaluation_population.exclusions: Only structurally invalid or empty descriptions may be excluded; counts and reasons must be reported.

frozen_gate.training_and_calibration_sources: Developer-authored positives; AerialVLN train negatives; AerialVLN val_seen negative calibration.

decision_rule.interpretation: Pass supports navigation-language abstention only; caution requires limitation language; fail blocks a robustness claim and cannot trigger retuning on this corpus.

blinding_and_change_control.permitted_after_registration_before_eval: Source download, hash capture, schema-only parser implementation, parser tests with synthetic fixtures, and manifest validation.
blinding_and_change_control.if_parser_or_source_integrity_fails: Mark the attempt invalid with an audit trail; do not report it as a model result.

claim_boundary: CityNav descriptions are navigation goals, not six-axis UAV operator preference labels. The final test estimates only false activation/abstention under a real-city language shift; it cannot estimate preference classification accuracy or make this development gate paper-ready.
